learningGoals: Understand the English Alphabet and the order of letters from A to Z (A-Z तक का सही क्रम). 📚
Identify Vowels (स्वर: a, e, i, o, u) and Consonants (व्यंजन: बाकी सभी अक्षर). 🅰️
Sort simple words in alphabetical order (शब्दों को डिक्शनरी के अनुसार लगाना). 📋
Recognize capital and small letters easily in different words. 🔡
Improve spelling skills by focusing on vowel sounds in simple words. 🗣️
conversationStarters: Can you tell me all the 5 magic vowels (स्वर) in the English alphabet? ✨
If we put 'Apple' and 'Ball' in order, which word comes first and why? 🍎⚾
What is your favorite letter, and can you name three things that start with it? ⭐
teachingTips: Explain vowels and consonants in Hindi: 'a, e, i, o, u स्वर हैं और बाकी अक्षर व्यंजन हैं।' 🗣️
Write your child's name and ask them to circle the vowels (स्वर) in it. 🖍️
Sing the ABC song together, but clap loudly every time you say a vowel! 👏
Give them 3-4 random letters and ask them to arrange them in the correct alphabetical order. 🧩
Use household items (e.g., Cup, Book, Pen) and ask them to name the starting consonant. 🏠

funActivities.title: Vowel Hunt 🔍
funActivities.description: Give your child a newspaper or an old magazine. Ask them to circle all the letter 'a's they can find in one minute. Repeat with other vowels.

funActivities.title: Alphabet Train 🚂
funActivities.description: Write letters on different pieces of paper. Mix them up and ask your child to connect them in the correct A to Z order to make a long train.

funActivities.title: Name Sorting 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦
funActivities.description: Write the names of 4 family members on slips of paper. Ask your child to arrange these names in alphabetical order.
